info.title: Evakuators.am — Live dispatch API
info.description:
Driver app, operator console and public live search. All paths are under
`/api/v1`. Errors are `{ code, message, details? }` where `code` is one of
`ErrorCode` — clients branch on `code`, never on `message` (Armenian text).

**Idempotency.** Every mutation marked `Idempotency-Key: required` must carry
a client-generated key (8–128 chars `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`). Repeating the same
key with the same body returns the original result (header
`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different body returns
`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`.

**Optimistic concurrency.** Operator mutations carry `expectedVersion`;
a stale one returns `VERSION_CONFLICT` with `details.currentVersion`.

**Time.** All timestamps are UTC ISO-8601. Countdown = `expiresAt − serverTime`
from the same response, never the device clock.

driverApp.description: App token from POST /driver-app/sessions (aud driver:app, bound to a revocable device session). The website's driver token is NOT accepted.

ops.description: Admin-panel session token (POST /admin-auth/login, 2FA if linked). Role ADMIN or DISPATCHER; settings PATCH requires ADMIN.

CancelReason.description: NOT_SPECIFIED: only in a driver CANCEL request, sent by the app when the driver picked no reason in time. An operator cancel requires a real reason.

Requirements.description: null = not asked. Since 2026-11 unknowns no longer block dispatch (assertDispatchable is a no-op); a known value still filters trucks.

needsWheelSkates.description: Operator asked for wheel skates (2026-11). true → only trucks WITH wheel skates (no crane substitute).

wheelSkatesCount.description: How many skates — shown to the driver; never a filter (no profile records a count).

pickup.description: Only `address` is mandatory (2026-11). latitude/longitude may both be null — such an order cannot start automatic search (PICKUP_LOCATION_REQUIRED), only a manual offer.

UpdateOrder.description: Any subset of CreateOrder fields. A change to pickup, destination, weight, requirements or pricing is MATERIAL — it bumps termsVersion and revokes a pending offer (the driver is re-offered the new terms).

pickup.description: Only `address` is mandatory (2026-11). latitude/longitude may both be null — such an order cannot start automatic search (PICKUP_LOCATION_REQUIRED), only a manual offer.

pickupToDestination.description: Road figures for the description only. null when no destination. `manual` = typed by an operator. Never a straight line.

Availability.description: Six independent facts — never one "online" boolean.

TrackingPolicy.description: A request to the app, not a promise — the OS decides actual delivery.

currentOffer.description: The live offer. Contains NO customer contact. `toPickup.etaSeconds` is null when the road could not be routed — then `straightLineMeters` is set and must be labelled «ուղիղ գծով».

fee.description: Driver wallet: what accepting costs; null while billing is off. `provisional`: no agreed price yet — the base fee, settled when the price is agreed.

activeOrder.description: The assigned order, WITH customer contact. `allowedActions`, `canCancel` (cancel request allowed: only before EN_ROUTE) and `canSetPrice` (driver may record the agreed price) are server-computed; the app only renders them.

hasBase.description: The driver has a base (parking) location. When his GPS is lost, dispatch still reaches him measured from it (BASE fallback).

wallet.description: Driver wallet (2026-11-12). `low`: billing is on and the balance is below the base fee — no offers until topped up (availability reason BALANCE_LOW).

measuredAt.description: Device clock; tolerated up to 30 s ahead

towTruckId.description: Website profile; set only for SITE_LINKED

isActive.description: May receive orders: app access ACTIVE. The website status plays no part

siteListed.description: Shown on the website right now (informational; no effect on the app)

post.summary: App login. A number registered on the website signs in with the website password (password only — the website status plays no part) and only if an admin granted app access; any other number is an app-only account
post.description: Throttled 10/min/IP. 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS; 403 APP_ACCESS_NOT_GRANTED / APP_ACCOUNT_PENDING / APP_ACCOUNT_REJECTED / APP_ACCESS_SUSPENDED (status only revealed after a correct password).

delete.summary: Logout — revokes this session and its push tokens; an active order is NOT cancelled
Withdraw location consent; the driver goes offline and tracking stops

409.description: ACTIVE_ORDER_IN_PROGRESS — open assignment or pending offer

get.summary: Full state snapshot — call on launch, on every WebSocket (re)connect, and when opened from a push

put.summary: The driver's own switches. Offline during an active order stops NEW offers only.

post.summary: App liveness. Does NOT refresh GPS freshness. Throttled 12/min.
1–50 fixes. Only the newest FRESH fix can become the current position; older ones are history. Throttled 30/min.

sound.description: Optional. The driver's new-order ring on this device; the iOS offer push names its bundled file (offer_<id>.wav, 'classic' = offer_alert.wav). Omitted keeps the stored choice.

post.summary: Accept. Show success ONLY on 200 — never optimistically.
The app rendered the offer (delivery fact — NOT an acceptance)

200.description: Recorded. `{ expiresAt }` — the offer's deadline after the answer window started (null when it is no longer pending); the app's alarm rings until then (2026-11, was 204)

post.summary: The assigned driver records the price he agreed with the customer by phone (NEGOTIATION_REQUIRED, not yet confirmed). Same effect as an operator's confirm-price; enabled when activeOrder.canSetPrice.

CANCEL (only before EN_ROUTE). Reason other than CUSTOMER_DECLINED and the pickup has coordinates → the driver is released and a new automatic search starts without him (response {released:true}); CUSTOMER_DECLINED → assignment KEPT until an operator decides. PROBLEM: any active status, an alert only.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The previous page's last `assignedAt` (paging cursor; the list is ordered by it, newest first)

200.description: The driver's own past orders, newest assignment first — no customer contact. Each item: id, number, status, pickupAddress, destinationAddress, price {mode, amountAmd}, createdAt, completedAt, cancelledAt, assignedAt (cursor), vehicle {make, model}, problemDescription, cancelReason, route {meters, seconds} | null, timeline {assignedAt, enRouteAt, arrivedAt, transportStartedAt}

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The previous page's last `offeredAt` (paging cursor; newest first)

200.description: Offers this driver let run out (status EXPIRED; not rejected, not withdrawn), newest first — no customer contact. Each item: offerId, offeredAt (cursor), expiresAt, reason NOT_DELIVERED | TOO_LATE | NO_ANSWER, toPickup {roadMeters, etaSeconds, straightLineMeters}, outcome TAKEN | CANCELLED | OPEN | CLOSED (never who took it), order {number, pickupAddress, destinationAddress, vehicle {make, model}, problemDescription, price {mode, amountAmd}, route {meters, seconds} | null}

post.summary: Create (DRAFT). Creating and starting dispatch are separate actions.

get.summary: Order + offers history + current attempt's ranked candidates + audit timeline

200.description: Back to DRAFT; pending offer revoked
Payment status set — independent of completion

post.summary: Progress on the driver's behalf (driver phoned) — audited as ADMIN
The one safe way to take an order from a driver — ends the assignment and optionally restarts the search in ONE transaction
Explicitly accept unknown requirements (audited, with a note ≥ 5 chars)
Offer to a chosen driver. Busy/reserved/inactive/suspended/capability can never be overridden; GPS/online/heartbeat/external-busy only with overrideReason (audited).
Compute pickup → destination road figures (never invented without a destination)
Operator-entered distance when the provider fails — stored and shown as manual

get.summary: Drivers who use the app, with position, fix age/accuracy and availability. Filter by viewport.

reason.description: Required when blocking; the driver reads it in the app

days.description: Block for this many days, then it lifts by itself; omitted = until lifted

200.description: Dispatch suspension toggled (the public profile is unaffected)
Effective settings (defaults merged with stored values)

patch.summary: ADMIN only. Each key range-checked and the combination validated before anything is stored.

200.description: Feature flags + outbox backlog / oldest due / dead letters

post.summary: Nearest drivers in ONE list: website drivers online in the app with fresh GPS are measured from where they are now (`live`), everyone else from their profile parking spot (the existing search)
post.description:
POST so the visitor's position never reaches access logs. Creates no order, reserves nobody, notifies nobody.
Only drivers with a public website card appear — app-only drivers never do. A driver is listed once.
Live entries carry NO coordinates — distance rounded to 100 m, time rounded to the minute.
Ranking = the existing search's rule for everyone: with a road time first (fastest first), then by straight line.
Throttled 10/min/IP; live part cached ~60 s per ~110 m cell; separate daily routing budget.
A result is not a reservation (`disclaimer: NOT_A_RESERVATION`).

skipRouting.description: Can only ask for LESS (no road figures)

towTruck.description: The public card (same shape as GET /tow-trucks)

live.description: Present only when measured from the live phone position

post.summary: Sign-up for a driver NOT on the website → PENDING_REVIEW (admin approves). Creates nothing public
post.description: Throttled 5/hour/IP. 409 PHONE_BELONGS_TO_SITE_DRIVER (use the website login), REGISTRATION_ALREADY_PENDING, PHONE_ALREADY_REGISTERED. A REJECTED number may apply again.

get.summary: App drivers (both kinds), pending first (ADMIN only)
Website profiles matching a search, with their current app access — for the grant picker (ADMIN only)

post.summary: Give a WEBSITE driver app access (or give it back). Their site login becomes their app login. 409 PHONE_HAS_APP_ONLY_ACCOUNT → use link-site (ADMIN only)
Approve an app-only registration (ADMIN only)
Reject an app-only registration (ADMIN only)
Take app access away (either kind): every device logged out at once. 409 DRIVER_BUSY while holding an order (ADMIN only)
Restore suspended access (ADMIN only)
Merge an app-only driver into a website profile: same driver id (history kept), site password from now on, devices logged out (ADMIN only)

The driver deletes his own app account (store requirement). APP_ONLY: personal data cleared, status DELETED, phone free again. SITE_LINKED: app access ends; the website profile is untouched. Location history, presence, sessions and push tokens deleted for both; order records kept without personal data.
Admin-only: delete a driver app account on the driver's request (the no-app path of /driver-app/delete-account). Same erase as the in-app deletion.
The app's sign-up (2026-11): the WEBSITE registration (same form, photos, consent and moderation) plus a password for the app
post.description: Body = `CreateRegistrationDto` of `POST /registrations` (backend/src/registration/dto) plus `password` (8–72). Upload photos first with `POST /images` (public, 10/min) and send their ids in `imageIds` (1–6, main first). Throttled 10/hour/IP. 409 REGISTRATION_ALREADY_PENDING (an app sign-up or app-only account for this number is already in review), PHONE_ALREADY_REGISTERED (an app-only account exists — sign in). Website rules answer as on `/register` (400, Armenian `message`, no `code`): number already on the site, stale `privacyPolicyVersion`, coverage cap, unusable images. On approval the profile goes public and the driver signs in to the app with this phone + password; the first sign-in grants app access (FleetAccess.authenticate). Before approval sign-in answers APP_ACCOUNT_PENDING, after rejection APP_ACCOUNT_REJECTED.

get.description: `SITE_LINKED`: `{ kind, siteActive, site, profile, change }` — `profile` is the website's `TowTruckApi` exactly as `GET /my/tow-truck` returns it (coordinates and owner fields included), `change` the moderation queue status (`DriverProfileChangeStatusApi`). `siteActive: false` = switched off on the website: shown, not editable. `APP_ONLY`: `{ kind, appAccount }`. `site` (2026-11-12): `{ state: LISTED|APP_ONLY|REQUESTED|REJECTED|DEACTIVATED, url, requestedAt, rejectionReason, telegramLinked, telegramAvailable }` — an app sign-up is hidden from the website (`APP_ONLY`) until it asks (`POST /driver-app/me/site-listing`) and an admin publishes it. `APP_ONLY` and `REQUESTED`/`REJECTED` profiles stay editable.

put.summary: Submit the website profile for moderation (PATCH /my/tow-truck from the app)
put.description: Body = `UpdateMyTowTruckDto`. Queues a diff, never writes; answers the queue status (`pending: null` = nothing differed). Same guards as the website: 402 when the subscription has lapsed. 403 SITE_PROFILE_REQUIRED for an app-only driver.

post.summary: Ask to be published on the website too
post.description: Only an app-only profile (`site.state` APP_ONLY or REJECTED). Body `{ note? }` (≤500). Creates a request an admin reviews (`/admin/site-listing-requests`). Returns the new `site` view. 409 when already listed, deactivated by an admin, or already requested.

post.summary: One-time t.me link to connect Telegram
post.description: Only for a profile that is on the website. `{ url, linked }` — `linked: true, url: null` when already connected. Linking never changes the driver's own password.

put.summary: Change the website password (= the app password of a website driver)
put.description: Body `{ currentPassword, newPassword }` (`ChangePasswordDto`). A wrong current password is 400, never 401. Throttled 10/min. 403 SITE_PROFILE_REQUIRED for an app-only driver.

put.summary: Submit the base parking coordinates for moderation (PATCH /my/tow-truck/coordinates from the app)
put.description: Body `SetCoordinatesDto` (`{ latitude, longitude }`, inside Armenia). Queued like every profile edit; 402 when the subscription has lapsed; 403 SITE_PROFILE_REQUIRED for an app-only driver.

200.description: Driver wallet (2026-11-12): billingEnabled, balanceAmd (may be negative after a settlement), fees {freeMaxPriceAmd, baseAmd, baseMaxPriceAmd, percent, roundAmd, maxAmd} (fee = 0 up to freeMaxPrice, base up to baseMaxPrice, then percent of the whole price rounded to roundAmd, at least base, at most maxAmd), topup {minAmd, maxAmd}, topupAvailable, entries (first statement page: id, kind TOPUP|ORDER_FEE|ORDER_FEE_ADJUSTMENT|ORDER_FEE_REFUND|ADMIN_CREDIT|ADMIN_DEBIT, amountAmd signed, balanceAfterAmd, orderNumber, note, createdAt), topups (recent bills: paymentId, amountAmd, status, createdAt)

A new PENDING Idram bill: {paymentId, amountAmd, status, payUrl}. Open `payUrl` (valid 30 min) in the phone's browser; the balance is credited when Idram confirms (poll me/wallet/topups/{paymentId}). WALLET_TOPUP_UNAVAILABLE without a website profile or payment credentials; VALIDATION_FAILED {min, max} for an amount outside the bounds.
One of the driver's top-up bills: {paymentId, amountAmd, status PENDING|PAID|FAILED|CANCELLED, createdAt}

PUBLIC text/html: the page that carries the driver's browser on to Idram's payment page for a PENDING bill (amount from the bill, never the link). Authorised by the signed, 30-minute `t` from `payUrl`.
Every app driver's wallet balance, lowest first: driverId, name, phone, kind, balanceAmd, updatedAt
One driver's wallet summary, statement (50 lines; `before` = last id) and recent top-ups

ADMIN only, Idempotency-Key required: credit (+) or debit (−) by hand → {driverId, balanceAmd}. The driver's app refreshes at once (realtime `wallet.updated`); a credit is also pushed («Ձեր հաշիվը համալրվեց»).

note.description: Optional; defaults to «Մուտքագրում/Գանձում ադմինիստրատորի կողմից». Shown to the driver.

200.description: ADMIN only, Idempotency-Key required: how far below zero this driver may go and still be offered orders → {driverId, balanceAmd, creditLimitAmd, availableAmd}

Wallet money over the last `days` (default 30): totals {topupsAmd, topupsCount, bonusesAmd, feesNetAmd, feeOrders, refundsAmd, adminCreditsAmd, adminDebitsAmd}, balances {heldAmd, owedAmd, inDebt, belowBaseFee}, pendingPriceReviews, daily [{day, topupsAmd, feesNetAmd, feeOrders}]

Minimum prices entered by drivers, waiting for a call to the customer (oldest first): id, orderId, orderNumber, driver {id, name, phone}, customer {phone, name}, pickupAddress, destinationAddress, routeMeters, priceAmd, createdAt

Idempotency-Key required. APPROVE: the price stands and the driver's provisional fee is returned. CORRECT {correctedPriceAmd}: the real price replaces it, the fee follows it, the driver is notified. → the order (admin view). PRICE_REVIEW_NOT_FOUND when already decided.
